description: Port-only: without functionCallValidation a call TS rejects runs as given this release, with a one-time warning.
expected_deprecations: A model function call TypeScript Ax rejects runs as given here: Function call at index 0 in result 0 must have type 'function', received: "tool". TypeScript Ax fails the forward at once. Pass functionCallValidation: 'fail' to fail it now, or functionCallValidation: 'correct' to keep running it. Failing becomes the default in the next major version.
name: function-call-wrong-type-runs-by-default
